simple.meaning: to inquire ; by implication, to request ; by extension, to demand
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁאַל (H7592) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 176 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׁאַל (shâʼal) means to inquire ; by implication, to request ; by extension, to demand First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 10.
